name: glitch-scanline-static
title: Glitch Scanline Static
description: Cathode-ray tube CRT monitor horizontal scanlines with subtle chromatic aberration bands.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Passive Crt Scanlines: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
